mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vi_dispatch_policy WHERE owner_dept_id=#{owner} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_dispatch_policy SET invite_response_seconds=#{row.inviteResponseSeconds},radius_meter=#{row.radiusMeter}, expanded_radius_meter=#{row.expandedRadiusMeter},overall_deadline_seconds=#{row.overallDeadlineSeconds}, license_compatibility=#{row.licenseCompatibility},config_hash=#{row.configHash}, updated_by_user_id=#{row.updatedByUserId},version=#{row.version},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE owner_dept_id=#{row.ownerDeptId} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type='vi_vehicle_type' AND dict_value=#{code} AND status='0'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_station s JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=s.dept_id JOIN sys_dept c ON c.dept_id=#{company} AND c.status='0' AND c.del_flag='0' WHERE s.id=#{station} AND d.status='0' AND d.del_flag='0' AND (d.dept_id=c.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(c.dept_id,d.ancestors))
SELECT s.name station_name,c.dept_name service_company_name FROM vi_order o JOIN vi_station s ON s.id=o.station_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept c ON c.dept_id=o.service_company_id WHERE o.id=#{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_order o
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_dispatch_invite i JOIN vi_order o ON o.id=i.order_id

SELECT session.account_id,session.active_role,session.context_version,session.status,session.revoked_at, session.absolute_expires_at,session.session_epoch,security.session_epoch current_epoch, security.security_status,account.status account_status FROM vi_session session JOIN vi_account account ON account.id=session.account_id JOIN vi_account_security security ON security.account_id=account.id WHERE session.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM vi_dispatch_invite WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM vi_dispatch_invite WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status='WAIT_RESPONSE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM vi_dispatch_batch WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY run_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM vi_dispatch_batch WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_dispatch_batch SET status=#{row.status},radius_stage=#{row.radiusStage},reason_code=#{row.reasonCode}, version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM vi_driver_profile WHERE owner_dept_id=#{owner} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_dispatch_cursor(scope_key,round_no) VALUES(#{key},0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scope_key=scope_key
mapper.select: SELECT last_driver_id,round_no,version FROM vi_dispatch_cursor WHERE scope_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_dispatch_cursor SET round_no=round_no+IF(last_driver_id IS NOT NULL AND #{driver}<=last_driver_id,1,0), last_driver_id=#{driver},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE scope_key=#{key} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE vi_dispatch_invite SET status=#{row.status},responded_at=#{row.respondedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, reason_cipher=COALESCE(#{row.reasonCipher},reason_cipher),version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND version=#{expected} AND status='WAIT_RESPONSE'

UPDATE vi_driver_occupancy SET holder_type='ASSIGNMENT',holder_id=#{assignment},expires_at=NULL, version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE driver_id=#{driver} AND order_id=#{order} AND holder_type='INVITE' AND holder_id=#{invite}
mapper.select: SELECT a.order_id FROM vi_driver_assignment a JOIN vi_order o ON o.id=a.order_id AND o.active_assignment_id=a.id WHERE a.driver_id=#{driver} AND a.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM vi_order WHERE fulfillment_status='PENDING_DISPATCH' ORDER BY dispatch_at,id LIMIT 200
SELECT id FROM vi_dispatch_invite WHERE status='WAIT_RESPONSE' AND expires_at<=#{now,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler} ORDER BY expires_at,id LIMIT 200
SELECT order_id FROM vi_dispatch_batch WHERE status IN ('RUNNING','WAIT_RESPONSE','PAUSED') ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
